trello.name: Send final DataBridge renewal email and escalate to legal if no reply
trello.desc: Sofia sends one final email today to DataBridge's account manager in plain language requesting the revised renewal terms by Thursday close of business. If no reply is received by Thursday COB, Sofia escalates to legal on Friday morning to review termination-for-convenience options. The contract lapses August 29th.

trello.name: Request Dana to review security audit cryptography and key management findings
trello.desc: Sofia messages Dana today, framing it as a request from Ravi, to review sections 4 and 6 of the 60-page external security audit report covering cryptography and key management findings. Dana should send her assessment to this group before the next sync in two weeks. If Dana lacks bandwidth, Ravi will take the request to her manager.

trello.name: Add logo decision line to rebrand FAQ
trello.desc: Tomas adds one line to the rebrand FAQ stating that the logo stays as-is and only the color palette changes, including a link to the March meeting notes where this decision was made, to stop the question from recurring every quarter. To be completed this week.
